title: China model logical sources
summary: This iteration promotes DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, and Zhipu/Z.ai official source lines into first-class logical sources under the fixed china_models section. It keeps the 154-entry inventory intact while reducing unmapped review candidates from 103 to 88.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source display contract governance|source insertion handbook|source order tuning review|source inventory order reference|tracking metrics logical sources|china model logical sources" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: High-importance China model vendors should have first-class source identities.
lessons.evidence: `deepseek-official`, `qwen-official`, `kimi-official`, `minimax-official`, and `zhipu-official` are now in `CORE_SOURCE_CONTRACTS` and `config/source-display-contract.json` under `china_models`.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the same small-batch promotion pattern for remaining China model and platform sources.

lessons.lesson: Official duplicate entrypoints should map together without absorbing mirrors.
lessons.evidence: Focused tests prove 15 official DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/Zhipu collection entries map to the new logical sources while GitHub and Hugging Face mirror rows do not map to those official identities.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future aliases source-id or official-domain specific to avoid stealing open-source platform rows.

lessons.lesson: Promotion must update review and inventory references together.
lessons.evidence: `docs/source-inventory-order.md` now maps the official China model entries to logical sources, and `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md` reduces unmapped sources to 88 and removes those promotion rows.
lessons.recommended_action: For every future promotion, update the executable contract, inventory reference, review surface, handbook, and tests in the same PR.

followups.action: Promote the next small China model/platform batch from `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md`, likely Tencent Hunyuan, ByteDance Seed, Baidu AI, and Alibaba Cloud AI after reviewing proposed ids and ranks.
